prescriptive_hits.text: - **DO NOT USE `git archive` FOR THIS — it returns the OPPOSITE of the blob on this box.**
This rule prescribed `git archive <rev> | tar -x -C <tmp>` until 2026-08-09 and was WRONG:
`git archive` applies export-time EOL conversion, so on Windows it hands back **CRLF**. Measured

platform.note: Parent worktree is not a git repo; three-route and autocrlf matrices run on an isolated fixture repo. On Linux, git archive does not apply core.autocrlf; archive→CRLF is reproduced via .gitattributes `text eol=crlf` (convert_to_working_tree), the same path Windows Git uses when archive emits CRLF.
